verdict.rationale: Poke is itself an AI assistant that reaches your connected data (email, calendar, integrated apps, MCP data sources) and answers about it in conversation. It can also build tables and charts from data you describe or share, and it is described as proactive, which covers in-product AI insights and suggestions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of proactive insight or suggestion features grounded in user data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
